signals.name: external_reference_exact
signals.description: Exact match on client_case_ref or provider_case_ref

signals.name: customer_name_similarity
signals.description: Normalized customer or account name similarity

signals.name: asset_identifier_match
signals.description: Exact or near-exact asset serial or unit identifier match

update.description: Use when the inbound packet clearly refers to an existing record under the same provider or operating owner

transfer.description: Use when the inbound packet clearly refers to an existing record but under a new provider or operating owner

new_record.description: Use when no existing record is a credible match

duplicate_review.description: Use when two or more records are plausible matches and a reviewer must resolve the ambiguity
